content: Our paper “Bayesian Robust Fully-Connected Tensor Network Decomposition for Visual Data Denoising” has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing.
Our paper “Bayesian Fully-Connected Tensor Network for Hyperspectral-Multispectral Image Fusion” has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing.
Our two papers, focusing on image editing and video editing, respectively, have been accepted for presentation at ICML 2026.
Our paper “Bayesian Federated Learning with Personalized Parameters for Cloud-Edge Collaboration” has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Cloud Computing.
Our paper “Bayesian Tensor Interpolative Decomposition for IoT-based Healthcare Data Multi-way Analytics” has been accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Journal.
Our paper “Bayesian High-order Tensor Completion Model with Its Applications in Social Intelligence” has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems.
Joined the School of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, Zhengzhou University.
